simplemobmanners.title: Simple Mob Manners
simplemobmanners.option.mutedEntities.to:
List of entity IDs (e.g. minecraft:cow) whose
sounds are silenced. Default: [].
simplemobmanners.option.nametagMuteSuffi:
List of name suffixes. Mobs named with one of
these will be silenced.
Default: ["_mute", "_shhh"].
simplemobmanners.option.nametagBabySuffi:
Babies named with one of these suffixes will
never grow up (e.g., _baby). Default:
["_baby", "_small"].
simplemobmanners.option.piglinsIgnoreGol:
Piglins won't attack if you wear armor with
gold trims. Default: true. Attacks and
container interactions can still anger
piglins.

Piglins won't attack if you hold gold tools
or weapons. Default: true. Attacks and
container interactions can still anger
piglins.
command.simplemobmanners.renamed: /%s is now /%s: Simple Creatures was renamed to Simple Mob Manners.
jei.simplemobmanners.info.frog_bucket: No recipe. Use a water bucket on a frog to catch it; its variant, name and age ride along. Using the bucket on the ground releases it.
